snippet.title: I Made a Cozy Game About Betta Fish 🐟 | Little Bettas
snippet.description:
Meet Little Bettas — my cozy pixel-art game about caring for, breeding and collecting betta fish. 🐟💙

A free public Steam demo is coming soon, and I’ll be looking for players to help test the game and find bugs.

Little Bettas — Free Demo Coming Soon on Steam
